resources.string: Liquid is the recorded balance across active wallets other than debt wallets. Across wallets includes debt wallets.
How is gain or loss calculated?
Gain or loss is your entered current value minus your entered cost basis, using the valuation date shown. It is a manual estimate, not a provider-reported return.
This planning amount uses the daily reference rate saved when you created the bill. Your payment provider may use a different rate.

Mizani parses the message on this phone and discards its text. To prevent duplicates, it keeps the provider reference, or an exact-message fingerprint if there is no reference. Mizani never reads SMS automatically.
Which transaction type should I use?
Transfer moves money between your wallets; it is not income or spending. Refund is money returned for an earlier expense. Adjustment corrects a wallet balance without recording income or spending.
